canonical_lanes.deploy_scope: Existing ASSETS-only owner preview, no zone routes

public_surfaces.notes: Existing V131-compatible gateway and 99/1 V136 controlled canary; do not promote broad work inadvertently
Current Next Signal page collides semantically with V5 /updates and /feed records; preserve deep links
Unlisted read-only actual V136; no member sign-in, private authoring, publishing or payments
Do not use as active V136 visual authority; retain until tested functional replacement
Prove active usage, bindings and redirects before retirement
Preserve functional inbound links and protected records
Brand tokens aligned; portfolio redesign delegated to its own project
Check permission and approved customer preview scope
Customer-specific prototype; not homepage V136 preview
Keep operator and RHEN authorization and release policies separate
Never merge protected lab or family data into public catalogue

route_collisions.decision: Choose one editorial taxonomy and preserve old article URLs before any redirect or Worker change
Link directly to /studio; keep old inbound links
Retain historical inbound alias; do not advertise nonexistent utility
Only one public root after full gated release, not by renaming both sources
